root_cause.description: Payment service rejecting charge requests (reoccurrence of INC-001)

evidence.ref: Trace: [ERROR: payment:Payment request failed. Invalid token]
evidence.why_it_matters: Confirmed exact same failure mode in 2 tool calls

prevention.change:
groups:
  - name: oncall-preventive-rules
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRatePayment
        expr: sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[2m])) / sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment"}[2m])) > 0.05
        for: 1m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service: payment
        annotations:
          summary: "Elevated error rate observed on payment"
          description: "Error ratio exceeded threshold for over 1 minute."
prevention.rationale: Detect service_fault_injected_errors on payment before full user impact occurs.
prevention.validation_detail: Valid PromQL expression verified against Prometheus

prevention.rationale: Add active health check probe on payment to detect degradation early.
prevention.validation_detail: Config syntax verified against compose spec

prevention.change:
Implement circuit breaker (e.g. Resilience4j / Tenacity / Polly):
- Trip open on 5 consecutive failures or > 50% error rate over 10s.
- Exponential backoff retry with jitter (100ms, 200ms, 400ms, max 3 attempts).
- Fallback response or degraded cache when circuit is open.
prevention.rationale: Prevent cascading failure and thread starvation when downstream dependencies fail.
